{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Correct population: all orders with status == 'completed' (i.e., not refunded)
# Conversion rate = (number of converted orders) / (total number of completed orders)

# Total completed orders by channel
total_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed'].groupby('channel').size()

# Converted orders by channel (converted == 1)
converted = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['converted'] == 1)].groupby('channel').size()

# Conversion rate
conversion_rates = converted / total_completed

# Difference (email - paid_search)
difference = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Print to verify
print("Total completed orders by channel:\n", total_completed)
print("Converted orders by channel:\n", converted)
print("Conversion rates by channel:\n", conversion_rates)
print("Difference (email - paid_search):", difference)"}
